tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sa skya pa'i yab chos rdo rje phur pa dang dpal kyai rdo rje'i sbyin sreg gi phyag len zhal shes ma sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros kyi phyag bris dngos las bshus pa 'phros don cung zad dang bcas pa don gnyer nyer mkho bzhugs// na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ye/ bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang chos rje dang / /gang gi thugs sras dam pa 'jam dbyangs mched/ /rgyal ba mus pa rje la gus btud nas/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i yab chos phur pa dang / /dges pa rdo rje'i bsnyen pa mthar phyin nas/ /sbyin sreg bya tshul bla ma brgyud pa yi/ /phyag len dri med lag len bya tshul dang / /'phros don cung zad dang bcas 'dir spel lo// ༈ /de la don gnyis te/ sa skya pa'i yab chos rdo rje phur pa dang dges pa rdo rje'i sbyin sreg gi phyag len zhal shes ma sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros kyi phyag bris dngos las 'byung ba bzhin bshad pa dang / de las 'phros pa'i don bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ kho bo cag rang lo bcu gcig lon skabs/ gcen 'jam pa'i dbyangs mthu stobs dbang phyug sku mched dang bcas pa byas 'gyur rdo rje'i brag rdzong du kyai rdo rje'i gzhi bsnyen mthar phyin nas/ bla brang nub tu sbyin sreg mdzad dus/ de skabs kyi phyag len rnams yab rje chos kyi rgyal pos phyag bris su bkod pa mdzad pa las 'di ltar 'byung ste// ༈ /phur pa dang kyai rdor sogs kyi sbyin sreg la phyag len the tshom che ba zhig yong gi 'dug pa nas/ nged rang gis phur pa kyai rdor sogs kyi bsnyen pa byas skabs/ sngags 'chang chen pos bka' bkod bslab ston phebs pa bzhin lag len byas pa gzhir bzhag ste/ khri thog pa spun rnams kyis phur pa gzhi bsnyen byas/ sbyin sreg skabs 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams dbang po la yang dogs gcod zhus rjes/ nged rang dpon slob bdun tsam gyis sbyin sreg byas dus phyag len gyi rim pa bkod pa la/

phur pa'i sbyin sreg la zhag bdun gyi/ tshugs pa'i nyin nyi ma phyed yol 'phral tshugs pa byas/ sbyin bsreg gi gzhung sa lo thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa bzhin las/ sngags kyi grangs dang sreg rdzas 'bul lugs ni de nub khri tsho gcig bzla/ 'das pa'i me lha'i sreg rdzas rnams bcu gcig pa thengs bcu gcig 'bul dgos pa'i/ thog mtha' gnyis la rdzas sngags so sos 'bul/ bar gyi tshan pa dgu po kī la ya 'ba' zhig gis 'bul lo/ /sngags stong phrag re'i mtshams su 'bul thengs re byed/ dpon slob mang po yod na mchod pa gtor bsngo sogs la rol chen byed/ gtor bsngo rgyas pa gtor 'bul skabs rol mo chems brdungs mdzad de/ de dgong thun gcig sang de nas bzung nyi ma drug po la nyin re la khri tsho phyed dang gsum gsum bzla zhing / snga dro shar skya la tshugs pa byed/ 'das pa'i me lha'i sreg rdzas 'bul lugs gong bzhin stong phrag gnyis re'i mtshams su 'bul thengs re re byas pa bdun dang / stong phrag re'i rjes su sreg rdzas 'bul thengs re re byas pa gsum ste/ yongs dril khri khrag gcig dang stong phrag bdun bzla/ dkar bdud phur srung gi gtor bsngo sogs mjug chog byas te snga thun grol mtshams gsol ba byed/ de nas dgong thun tshugs pa'i sreg rdzas 'bul lugs gong bzhin la brgyad brgya re'i mtshams su 'bul thengs re re byas pa bcu phul la yongs dril stong phrag brgyad bzla/ gtor bsngo rgyas pa mjug chog byas te/ phyag len la thun gnyis ma mdzad/ grol ba'i snga gro gong bzhin khri phrag gcig bzlas pas kha gso'i grangs lhag tsam 'gro zhing / gtor bsngo rgyas pa dang bkra shis rgyas par bya'o/ /phur pa'i sbyin sreg gi phyag len 'khrul med kyi rim pa bkod pa'o// ༈ /kyai rdo rje'i sbyin sreg skabs kha gso byed tshe de wā pi tsu khri phrag bzhi byed/ sbyin sreg kyang gong bzhin thog mtha' gnyis la rdzas sngags so so dang /

gzhan ma de wā pi tsu 'ba' zhig gis 'bul zhing / tshugs pa'i dgong khri phrag gcig bzla/ sreg rdzas rnams stong phrag re re'i mtshams su 'bul/ gtor bsngo rgyas pa mdzad/ sang nyin shar skya la tshugs pa byas/ snga thun la khri phrag gcig bzla/ gtor bsngo sgrub mchod snga chog lugs bzhin bsdus pa mdzad/ 'di'i mtshams su gsol ba mdzad/ dgong thun la yang khri phrag gcig bzla/ gtor bsngo rgyas pa/ grol ba'i snga dro khri phrakhrag gcig bzla/ gtor bsngo rgyas pa/ sreg rdzas 'bul lugs kyang tshugs pa'i dgong mo bzhin no/ /bkra shis rgyas par bya/ nyi ma gsum la 'gro /bar ma la thun gnyis mdzad/ stan thog gcig ma mi dgos/ chab sang dgos tshe dpon slob mang po yod na re mos kyis nam dgos la phyin pas 'thus/ mjug chog ma grol bar ngag bcad byed/ sbyin bsreg gi gzhung yongs 'dzin dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa bzhin no/ /'di lce bde lod la spags pa'i sngags kyi grangs kyi mtshams su sreg rdzas rnams 'bul lugs byed do/ /kyai rdo rje'i sbyin sreg gi phyag len 'khrul med bkod pa'o/ /sbyin sreg thams cad la 'dis rigs 'gre'o/ /de dag gis ni rdo rje phur pa dang kyai rdo rje'i sbyin sreg gi phyag len yab rje grags pa'i mtshan can gyi phyag bris dngos las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin bshad pa bstan zin nas// ༈ /gnyis pa de las 'phros pa'i don bshad pa ni/ de ltar gong du bstan pa ltar gyi phur pa dang kyai rdor gyi sbyin sreg gi phyag len 'di ni sngags 'chang chen po yab sras kyi phyag len 'khrul med yin pas da phyin lag len byed pa rnams 'di'i nang bzhin bsre lhad med par mdzad pa zhu zhing / gzhan ma gsung rab kyi go ba gang yang ma chags pa'i lag len pa rgan po blun po dag gi ngag bgros kyis rjes su 'brangs na/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i gsung las/ bla ma'i phyag len bla ma yis/

/mdzad pa mthong zhing mdzad ces pa/ /ham lab gnyis phung ham lab can/ /tshod cig rang sems tshod cig zungs/ /'di bzhin rang bzo'i nga rgyal can/ /phyag len yang por gtong byed cing / /mi shes shes rgya'i rgyab rten du/ /bla ma zhing gzhan gshegs pa kun/ /gsung zhes bla ma'i zhabs 'dren byed/ /ces gsungs pas 'di 'dra'i rigs can mang po zhig byung dogs pas blo gsal don gnyer rnams kyis/ blun pos glen pa bteg pa'i ri bo bcal brgyugs kyi rjes su mi 'brang ba gal che'o/ /deng sang rang re rnams rgyun par mdzad pa'i sa skya pa'i thugs dam gtor ma'i rim pa dkar cha bzhi 'di nyid tshod ma sogs bzhes ma tshar ba lto stong la mdzad pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ skabs der su rū pa'i sngags kyis yi dwags la gtor ma bsngo ba 'di nyid nges par lto stong mar bya dgos pa yin te/ de nyid rang gi gzhung las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ zas ma zos pa'i gong du sbyin par bya'o/ /zhes dang / de'i rgyu mtshan yang rnal 'byor zas zos nas su rū pa'i sngags kyis gtor ma byin kyang / zas kyi mdangs dang zil mi bzod pas yi dwags kyi gtor ma len mi nus par bshad do/ /des na dkar cha bzhi lto stong ma mdzad pa'i dgongs gzhi ni 'di kho na yin pas/ gzhan chab gtor klu gtor/ gtor ma brgya rtsa sogs la lto stong ma sogs dus kyi nges pa mi dgos pa'i gnad kyang de yin no/ /'o na sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i klu gtor gyi yi ge las/ klu gtor gyi bdag bskyed grub pa'i skabs der/ dkar cha bzhi rgyun du byed mkhan yin na 'di'i mtshams su byed/ ma byas kyang nyes pa med pas bzhag pas chog zhes gsungs pas/ chab gtor sogs kyang lto stong ma bya dgos pa ma yin nam snyam na/ sngags 'chang nyid kyi gsung de ni/ dkar cha bzhi rgyun du byed bzhin pa de gong du ma grub pa klu gtor dang sbrel nas gtong na skabs der bya zhes pa'i don yin gyis/

chab gtor klu gtor sogs lto stong ma bya dgos pa sogs kyi don ma yin pa gong ma'i gsung rab lan gcig bklags pa tsam gyis go ba yin no/ /chab gtor klu gtor gtong ba'i skabs su gtor ma rnams kyi bya ba ma grub bar la zho chang gi rigs zhal la mi reg pa ni bla ma gong ma rnams kyi phyag len 'khrul med lags pas/ rjes 'jug rnams kyis las sla dang sla chos su ma song ba zhig mdzad 'tshal/ zhes pa'i 'phros don cung zad dang bcas pa'i legs bshad don gnyer nyer mkho zhes bya ba 'di yang / rigs ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs dbang po'i mtshan can sku mched dang / rgyal ba mus pa chen po buddha'i mtshan can rnams gtso bor smos pa'i yongs 'dzin mkhas pa rnams kyi gsung las skyes pa'i sa skya pa chos med sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis/ rigs kyi bu ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug la sogs te rang dang skal ba mnyam pa'i don gnyer gyi slob ma'i tshogs rnams la phan par bsam ste/ legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni lugs gnyis rnam dpyod kyi spyan mig gsal ba mtsho sgo ba mi dbang rnam rgyal rdo rjes phyag sor gyi 'du byed las bskrun pa'o/ /dge ba 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba'i mthu'i/ /bdag gzhan las nyon sdig sgrib kun byang nas/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bsam don 'grub/ /phyi ma lhan cig dag pa'i zhing bsgrod shog /de de bzhin du gyur cig de las gzhan du nam yang ma gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ/ gcig zhus// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 a myes zhabs/ sa skya pa'i yab chos rdo rje phur pa dang kye rdor sbyin sreg gi phyag len zhal shes ma/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
